svg.text: Dosidicus — run 19: brain growth, plasticity and feeding
Three modes · seed 11 · 240,000 ticks each · repaired anxiety relief loop · same four-phase world
Every condition: 19,145 growth requests stood down; hunger dominates the rejected requests after initial growth.
Full study: no births after tick 3,750, no feeding after early life, and no births in the west/fouling/retention phases.
Source: ci-logs/19/results/growth_timeseries_*.csv and growth_events_*.json · Early birth circles colour-coded by diagnosed deficit.
